message: `aria-busy="true"` on the host of PctPending sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A component whose host block writes `aria-busy: 'true'`, its template holding an error part with its `alert`. Firefox 158 hands every part below a busy custom element `container-busy="true"` (measured on 2026-10-27). The host is above every part of the template, and point 7 read none of it.
